Hi welfare team,
Spirited block so far, and the duty handler discussed a question about pet arrivals. I want to keep our Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with the welcome team, since the most settled check-ins still depend on clear handoffs and calm updates. Please keep the desk ledger notes tidy and pass any last-minute service changes through the senior coordinator before the next bank of arrivals.

<<FACT F092>> The team should keep one eye on carrier condition, document any comfort concerns, and greet each family with steady guidance. <<FACT F086>> If a traveler seems unsure, a brief reassurance at the counter helps more than a long explanation, and it keeps the flow smooth for everyone involved.

Thanks for staying flexible and kind with each case. Small details make a real difference, and the animals and their people feel that care straight away.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
